opening.argument: The presentation explains a proposed technical architecture: zero-knowledge proofs as a way to make sharding work, users proving their own transactions locally, and miners aggregating those proofs. A slide on proof of useful work supports that technical account. The speaker also identifies a chain implementing the architecture and points listeners to Psy.xyz for details and Twitter/X for updates. Those references give the talk a promotional and forward-looking element, but the material shown remains an explanation of how the system is proposed to work. Nothing in the cited material asks viewers to pay, transfer assets, provide credentials, or authorize a transaction. The project references do not, by themselves, turn this technical presentation into a transaction request.
